phasePolicy.created/signing: Retire local preparation using actual owner CAS; legacy nil history allowed only here.
phasePolicy.candidateReady+neverStarted: Only new actual create can write this negative history; safe local retirement/replacement.
phasePolicy.legacy candidateReady+nil: Retain; empty path is not negative history proof.
phasePolicy.candidateReady+started: Requires actual sealed pre-submission Remove and StopSession summary written in the same cleanup commit.
phasePolicy.uploadIntent: Fresh authenticated cleanup first; never direct retirement.
phasePolicy.upgradeIntent/installationUnknown/lookup: Retain; no automatic retirement or another preparation, regardless of same-version/not-found Lookup.
phasePolicy.retirementPending: No new create until actual fixed-name owned cleanup + directory fsync + retired publication.
phasePolicy.retired: Confirm actual candidate absence and directory fsync; next create keeps one predecessor id/raw hash.

cancellation: Before pending admission and before resume: throw CancellationError without mutation. After pending commit: synchronous admitted cleanup/terminal publication ignores subsequent task cancellation; actual I/O failure retains pending for a new task. New create still checks cancellation at publication.
clock: No scheduler, retry time, deadline or backoff is introduced. Journal dates must be finite/nondecreasing; predecessor date must not follow a new record creation date.
fixtureLimits: Pending/unlinked/synced states use actual owned file operations and reopen. They are not OS termination or power-loss experiments.
No hardware fsync-failure injection or actual Swift execution occurs on Windows.
Owned package/CMS/TLS fixtures establish no Apple/device/install/cold-launch/user-data authority.
